symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate of position $k$ on axis $\kappa$, an integer from $0$ to $n_\kappa-1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\gamma_\kappa$ be the coordinate of position $k$ on axis $\kappa$, the exponent $\mu_\kappa k$ reduced modulo $n_\kappa$

symbols.name: mixed-radix digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of position $k$ at place $\kappa$, an integer from $0$ to $n_\kappa-1$.

symbols.name: place value
symbols.meaning: The number of distinct digit strings on the axes before axis $\kappa$, namely $n_1\cdots n_{\kappa-1}$.
symbols.quote: The place value of axis $\kappa$ is $\pi_\kappa=n_1\cdots n_{\kappa-1}$, the number of distinct digit strings on the axes before $\kappa$, with $\pi_1=1$.

symbols.name: monomial exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of $\nu_\kappa$ in a monomial of the standard basis, an integer from $0$ to $n_\kappa-1$.
symbols.quote: where $\eta_\kappa$, an integer from $0$ to $n_\kappa-1$, is the exponent of $\nu_\kappa$.

relations.quote: The Chinese-remainder map relabels the positions of a [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md).
It places the coefficients of a [radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) on distinct prime cyclic axes.
The map labels each position by its [mixed-radix digits](mixed-radix-digits.md) for the axis lengths.
